title: Classic Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with chicken, rice, and a blend of spices, slow-cooked in a clay pot.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Heat oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the chicken and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the broth, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the algerian rice.
